source.raw_text:
Solution Architect - Integration Platform
Acme Corp | Sydney or Melbourne based. | Full time | Ref ACM-2026-0417

Acme Health Holdings is a private health insurer running claims and provider
integration for 2.1 million members. Australian health data residency shapes
every decision we make about where our systems run.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the target-state architecture for our integration platform and hold design authority across four delivery squads. You will influence senior clinical and commercial stakeholders without direct authority.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own the target-state architecture for the claims integration platform and hold design authority across four delivery squads.
- Coordinate delivery with our offshore integration partner and hold them to the architecture.
- Chair the fortnightly architecture review forum with clinical and commercial representatives.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience designing enterprise integration platforms at scale (8+ years).
- Deep familiarity with Australian health data residency and privacy obligations.
- Hands-on with Azure integration services (APIM, Service Bus, Logic Apps) within the last two years.
- A bachelor's degree in a technical discipline and six years in architecture roles, or a postgraduate qualification in a related field.

NICE TO HAVE

- Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code experience is highly regarded.
- Exposure to HL7 FHIR would be an advantage.
- TOGAF certification or equivalent is well regarded but not essential.

WORKING HERE

Our hybrid model asks for three days a week in the Sydney office.

Applicants must hold full Australian working rights. We are not able to offer sponsorship for this role.

REMUNERATION

Base salary $185,000 - $215,000 plus superannuation, with a discretionary bonus of up to 15%.

HOW WE HIRE

Our process is a talent partner call, a conversation with the Head of Architecture, an architecture case study presented to a panel, a cross-functional panel, and reference checks. The case study runs to 90 minutes and is not compensated.
